description: Header file defining classes and functions for Vault management, including Vault and VaultNetflix classes, with methods for key import/export, deletion, and retrieval, as well as internal data structures and external dependencies related to security and cryptography.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Manages cryptographic vault operations, including key storage, import/export, and deletion, with support for persistent storage and thread safety.

classes.name: VaultNetflix
classes.description: Specialized vault class for Netflix-related cryptographic operations, including key management, ESN handling, and bound key loading.

classes.name: MapStore
classes.description: Data store class for managing cryptographic keys with export/import capabilities.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of a stored item by ID.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports a key blob into the vault.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports a key by ID into a buffer.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a key blob into the vault.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a key blob by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key by ID.

methods.name: ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Imports a named key from a file.

methods.name: CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new named key.

methods.name: CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks existence of a named key.

methods.name: ProcessorRelease
methods.description: Releases the cryptographic processor handle.

methods.name: loadBoundKeys
methods.description: Loads bound keys from a buffer.

methods.name: ESN
methods.description: Retrieves the ESN (Electronic Serial Number).

methods.name: GetNamedKey
methods.description: Retrieves a named key by name.

methods.name: AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key to the internal map.

methods.name: DeleteKeyFromMap
methods.description: Deletes a key from the internal map.

methods.name: GetNewKeyHandle
methods.description: Generates a new key handle.

methods.name: getKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a key handle.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key handle.

methods.name: FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by handle.

methods.name: esn
methods.description: Returns the ESN string.

methods.name: FindNamedKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle by name.
